partnershipPlan: Two people who went through contact evaluation last year and a shelter worker review the future-state map and the letters to contacts.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments from the program's contact satisfaction cards are read.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I work nights; getting to the clinic for blood and then again for the X-ray meant losing two shifts.
items.implication: Offer evening home visits and same-visit booking.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: By the time the letter comes, half the people it is for have moved to another shelter.
items.implication: Draw blood in shelters on the first visit.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The fax goes to the central office, and nobody tells me for a week that my contact was positive.
items.implication: Route results directly to the case nurse.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The nurse on the phone had an interpreter, but at the clinic nobody could explain the blood test to my mother.
items.implication: Book interpreters for every step, not only the first call.

summary: Four composite voices on work shifts, shelters, lost results and language.
